title: Number of Boomerangs
problemStatement: Given the coordinates of N distinct points, count the number of boomerangs. A boomerang is an ordered tuple of three distinct points (i, j, k) such that the distance from i to j equals the distance from i to k.
input: • First line contains integer N. • Next N lines contain two integers representing the coordinates.
output: Print the total number of boomerangs.
